card.name: Video game and fiction titles, early letters
card.fires_on: Early pieces of game and fiction titles and names, such as the O in Ocarina of Time, the G in Gondor, or the words leading into a Zelda title. Also seen on a quote mark or a space just before a number.

modes.label: Game and story titles
modes.description: Opening letters or lead-in words of a named game, place or character, especially Nintendo 64 and Zelda text.

modes.label: Space or quote before a number or term
modes.description: A space or opening quote mark that comes right before a number or a quoted term.

card.writes: It pushes toward name-like continuations and away from brick and block words.
card.plain: It fires when a game or story title has just begun and the rest of the name is still to come.
